 By: Bill Kardas 
 Bill Kardas

 14 hrs ago

 The dry, pleasant weather we've enjoyed for the back half of October will continue. Partly sunny skies today and seasonably warm, with highs near 60. Partly cloudy tonight and not as chilly, with overnight lows near 40. Low pressure brings a surge of warmth ahead of it for Thursday, with partly sunny skies and highs in the upper 60s. A cold front arrives Thursday night, bringing a round of showers. Cooler and breezy on Friday, with partly sunny skies and highs in the upper 50s.
 The weather for Halloween weekend looks fantastic! Partly sunny skies on Saturday, with highs in the mid 50s. Perfect weather for the kids in the evening, with dry weather and light winds. Mostly cloudy on Sunday, with highs in the low 60s. Mostly cloudy on Monday, with highs in the low 60s. Rain returns Tuesday, with highs in the mid 60s.
